title: Booking and Tickets
summary: Ticket categories and activities available to book for the 2027 National Show.

children.text: One booking allows a visitor to purchase any combination of Orchid Exhibition tickets, Sunset Cocktails, Workshops and Field Trips. Exhibition ticket categories planned for 2027 are the Early-Bird Exhibition Ticket, the Day Visitor Ticket and the Weekend Pass, plus a VIP Ticket for the Thursday evening opening. Final ticket categories, availability and pricing are confirmed on the booking page.
See the current ticket types and book online.
